name: Alex Morgan
message: Hello! I am looking for a studio in Griffintown for November. I work full-time and prefer a quiet building. Are cats permitted, and is the advertised rent inclusive of heating? I could visit after 5 p.m. on weekdays.

name: Camille Dubois
message: Bonjour! Le logement une chambre près du centre-ville m’intéresse. Je cherche pour le 1er décembre. Est-ce possible de visiter durant la fin de semaine? Je voudrais aussi savoir si les électroménagers sont inclus.

name: Jordan Lee
message: Interested in the one-bedroom unit. I can be flexible by two weeks on the move-in date. I have a small dog; please confirm pet policy and whether indoor parking is offered. I am comparing a few options.
Is this apartment still available? Please send more details and the next viewing date.

name: Samira Haddad
message: We are two adults looking for a two-bedroom apartment early next year. We would like a dishwasher, laundry and transit nearby. Can you confirm the lease length and whether there are any move-in promotions?

name: Thomas Reed
message: I found this two-bedroom listing, but it may no longer be available. Could you let me know if it is coming back, or suggest a similar unit under my budget? I would prefer a place close to public transportation.

name: Sofie Nielsen
message: Hej! We are interested in the two-room-bedroom apartment in Copenhagen. Is the rent quoted in DKK, and are utilities billed separately? We can provide employment documentation and would like an online viewing.

name: Emil Sørensen
message: Hej, I am relocating for a new job and looking for a small Copenhagen studio from May. Is bicycle storage available? I can be flexible by a couple of weeks and would appreciate details about the deposit and prepaid rent.

name: Maja Petersen
message: I saw that this apartment is pending. Please keep my enquiry on file in case it becomes available. Do you allow pets, and is the nearest metro within walking distance?

name: Taylor Kim
message: I have not chosen a particular listing yet. Looking for a one-bedroom in Montreal with a gym and in-unit laundry. I work remotely and would prefer a quieter building. Please share options that fit my budget.
